subject: Bracken boar
verdict: accepted as a convincing stylized boar and polished five-performance workbench study

brief.physicalInterpretation: living boar expressed as a warm umber fantasy sculpture
brief.gesture: low heavy trunk and loaded shoulders; wedge snout leads rooting and short charge
brief.identity: long nasal wedge, short strong neck, fitted tusks, rooted pointed ears, paired cloven hoof digits
brief.surface: quiet broad coat planes, darker keratin and bristle mantle, warm ivory tusks

views.judgment: Boar identity reads without pigment. Shoulder-to-snouted-head line is continuous; short limbs end in two distinct hoof digits. Rear stance and tail remain legible.

Tusks frame the snout without detaching from the cheek. Broad warm coat remains quiet; dark hooves and bristle ridge distinguish regions. Ears are rooted leaf volumes, not the rejected floating discs.
390 px layout retains snout, tusks, ears and low barrel; controls wrap without horizontal overflow.

The rejected enlarged root extreme exposed a hard weight-region split under the cheek and belly. Continuous distance-weighted limb blending removes the serrated pinch while preserving the existing mesh.

idle.review: Actual 1x: restrained breath and scent-oriented head motion, small delayed ear response, planted heavy body.

walk.review: Actual 1x and 12 fps decoded frames: deliberate staggered four-beat steps, low hoof recovery and small supported weight shift; repeated cycles close.

trot.review: Actual 1x and 16 fps decoded frames: quicker diagonal exchange and greater recovery height distinguish trot from walk. Compact body motion retains weight.

root.review: Actual 1x: gradual lower, sustained small rooting sweeps, measured recovery. Final enlarged native clay confirms continuous neck and clear ground.

charge.review: Actual 1x scene-travel recording: gather, two short driving steps over 1.2 model units, brake and recover. The path has a single scene-transform owner; final pose holds.

repairs: Replaced detached subdivided ear discs with rooted tapered closed volumes.
Replaced tall uniformly repeated dorsal spikes with a lower rooted mantle and small bristle tips.
Embedded tusk roots and fitted mouth line more closely.
Fixed Blender action-slot mismatch by sampling saved controls into character-bound actions.
Reduced saved rooting head pitch to clear the snout from the floor.
Reduced excess saved mesh density to 86,206 delivered triangles without rebuilding the sculpt.
Repaired hard limb/head skin-weight boundaries exposed by enlarged native rooting clay.

technical.browser: final repaired boar: 2 passed; earlier unchanged shared viewer regression: 7 functional passes, 3 other-subject native prerequisite skips

limits: Owner self-review is not independent visual approval or user approval.
No motion capture, measured animal reference or calibrated biomechanics; reference fidelity unassessed.
Stylized broad sculpture and simplified bristle forms; no fur or dirt simulation.
Flat planted hoof soles; no claim of biomechanical hoof rolling.
Construction recipes make new candidates; native refinements and saved masters are delivery authority.
